name: Fukuzumi Yuki
source: A cheerful girl happily cheering for her favorite team during a baseball game Masato is watching on TV. He uses an application to have sex with her virtually without leaving his living room. The cameras train on her and captures each moment as she is exposed and has sex for the first time live on TV.
